en.title: System Shock 2 Remaster is FREE to KEEP on Epic Games Store
en.summary: A legendary title in the immersive sim genre is now available at no cost. Players can claim the enhanced version of System Shock 2 and own it forever.
en.body:
PC players, take note: a monumental piece of gaming history is yours for the taking. The **System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster** is currently available for free on the **Epic Games Store**, and the best part is, it’s yours to keep permanently once claimed. This isn't a limited-time trial; anything you add to your library during this promotional window will remain yours long after the offer expires on October 8, 2026.

This isn't just a simple port; **Nightdive Studios**, the acclaimed team responsible for breathing new life into classics like **Quake** and **Star Wars: Dark Forces**, has meticulously updated **System Shock 2**. Released in June 2025, the 25th Anniversary Remaster retains the original game's groundbreaking design while significantly modernizing its presentation and gameplay. Expect remastered visuals that bring the terrifying corridors of Citadel Station to life with enhanced cutscenes, detailed character models, and sharper weapon designs. The technical upgrades are equally impressive, supporting resolutions up to 4K at a silky-smooth 144fps, with adjustable field of view and ultrawide support for maximum immersion. Crucially, full mod support is integrated, ensuring the vibrant modding community can continue to enhance the experience. For those who enjoy cooperative play, the remaster also introduces cross-play co-op for up to four players.

## A Genre-Defining Masterpiece

Originally released in 1999, **System Shock 2** is widely regarded as one of the most influential games ever made. Its masterful blend of environmental storytelling, player choice, and survival horror laid the groundwork for countless titles that followed, shaping the immersive sim genre as we know it. Players are thrust into the role of a United Nations Space Alliance soldier who awakens from cryosleep aboard the starship Von Braun, only to find the crew brutally murdered and the ship overrun by grotesque mutants. The game expertly weaves a narrative through audio logs, computer terminals, and the chilling presence of the malevolent AI, SHODAN. Its impact is undeniable, with a dedicated fanbase that has kept its legacy alive for decades. The original title earned a stellar 9/10 in updated reviews, a testament to its enduring quality.

## Why This Freebie Matters to Fans

For many, **System Shock 2** is more than just a game; it's a formative experience that defined a generation of PC gaming. The opportunity to revisit this seminal work with modern enhancements, and at absolutely no cost, is a dream come true for many. It also serves as an incredible entry point for newer gamers curious about the roots of titles like **BioShock**, which owes a significant debt to **System Shock 2**'s design philosophy. The extended availability until 2026 means there's ample time for everyone to grab this gem. Alongside **System Shock 2**, **Epic Games** is also offering **Buried Stars**, an anime-style visual novel where contestants must survive a mysterious attack, making this week a double treat for bargain hunters.

## What's Next

While the free offer for **System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster** runs until October 8, 2026, fans of the franchise might also be interested in **Nightdive Studios'** full remake of the original **System Shock**, which was released in 2023 and is available on PC. This free giveaway is the perfect chance to immerse yourself in the chilling world of **System Shock 2** before diving into its predecessor or exploring other offerings on the **Epic Games Store**.

content_raw: PC players can currently pick up System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster for free on the Epic Games Store until October 8, 2026. As with all of Epic's weekly freebies, anything you claim during the window stays in your library permanently. You'll need a free Epic Games account to claim System Shock 2, and the game is played through the Epic Games Launcher. Nightdive Studios, the team behind a string of well-regarded classic revivals such as those for Quake and Star Wars: Dark Forces, released the 25th Anniversary Remaster in June 2025. The update keeps the original design but modernises how it looks and plays, including the following changes: Remastered visuals, including cutscenes, character models, and weapon models Support for up to 4K at 144fps on PC Adjustable field of view and ultrawide support Full mod support Cross-play co-op for up to four players The choice of an O.S.A., Marine, or Navy s blend of environmental storytelling and player choice has shaped plenty of what has followed. The original title garnered a 9/10 rating when it received an updated review. Now, this Epic Games Store deal offers a free way to revisit one of the most influential games ever made. If the remaster whets your appetite, Nightdive also released a full remake of the first System Shock on PC in 2023, rebuilt with new HD visuals, updated controls and a revamped hacking system. It's a handy way to explore the series' roots, though System Shock 2 works perfectly well as a standalone adventure – that's currently $11.99 on Steam with a hefty 70% discount during the Autumn Sale . Epic is also giving away Buried Stars this week, so it's worth heading to the store for both. It's an anime-style visual novel in which a group of contestants on a TV show must survive a mysterious attack. Like System Shock 2, it's available to claim until 8 October, and you can add both games to your library in a couple of clicks.
